notes: Erfcx is computed as Erfc[z] * Exp[z^2] (Wolfram 14.3's Erfcx N[] is partial).
Decimal inputs are always wrapped as Rational[num,den] to dodge the MachinePrecision input-trap (R5 §3.1).
Refusal records (refusal.class = 'wolfram/symbolic-unevaluated') mark inputs Wolfram declined to evaluate numerically.
